title: Marguerite and the Trail
author: B. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Edmund Quintana, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
